verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an implementation-relevant thumbnail-production policy against AI-created assets while allowing limited Photoshop Generative Fill edits; the unrelated delivery deadline is not encoded.
The freelancer's proposed generation of elements and alteration of photographs materially conflicts with the client's limited-edit preference and requires clarification.
The client prohibits generating new elements and using the proposed generative methods to alter photographs; the existing policy keys are replaced without leaving stale conflicting attributes.
The client defines the permitted editing behavior as limited Photoshop Generative Fill touch-ups, such as removing a distracting background prop; no obsolete separate key requires removal.
The client resolves the material workflow uncertainty by specifying the acceptable limited-edit exception, returning the policy to an actionable state.
The client adds an implementation-relevant workflow constraint concerning uploading thumbnail images to external generative-AI services for modification.

The client prohibits wholesale AI content generation even when an existing photograph is used as the starting point; the new policy attribute is compatible with the retained limited-touch-up exception.

The client unambiguously accepts the proposed workflow requiring manual Photoshop creation of complete assets and limiting AI to minimal Generative Fill touch-ups; the updated keys leave no stale incompatible policy.
